status_definitions.verified: The recorded target has reproducible repository or command evidence.
status_definitions.partially_verified: Some representative evidence exists, but the stated metric or coverage is incomplete.
status_definitions.not_baselined: No versioned corpus or repeatable measurement exists; no value may be claimed.

checks.metric: Tracked project documentation reflects current implementation and boundaries
checks.target: All tracked project documentation uses implemented, conditional, or not implemented status
checks.current: Platform documents aligned on 2026-09-04, including module-based administrator configuration and configuration write permissions
checks.limitations: Fixture README files describe test targets and are not product capability statements.

checks.metric: Backend registry, frontend fallback, and project report boundaries use calibrated claims
checks.target: No current claim of industry knowledge base, full system behavior monitoring, or cross-project ASPM
checks.current: Calibrated and protected by backend regression tests
checks.limitations: Copy review cannot replace functional acceptance of the underlying scanners.

checks.target: All runnable tests pass with the Agent staging directory on D:
evidence: python -m pytest apps/api/tests -q with TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR on D:
checks.limitations: This count is historical, not a rerun of the full suite. On 2026-09-04 only the five targeted auth/configuration/SCA/SAST/AGENT policy test files were run: 62 passed. No full backend suite was requested or run.
Vite reports a chunk-size warning; browser smoke suites cover authentication, role-aware navigation, and governed workspaces at 1600px and 390px but are not a complete end-to-end product suite.

checks.metric: Alembic schema is at repository head
checks.target: Current database revision equals the repository migration head
checks.limitations: This verifies the local development database, not backup, rollback, or production upgrade readiness.

checks.metric: A previously unseen project can be safely imported, inventoried, readiness-checked, and scanned in bounded quick mode
checks.target: Local directory, guarded ZIP, and HTTP(S) Git inputs produce project-scoped readiness and bounded static scan results
checks.current: Local and ZIP API smoke checks pass; full manifest recognition and quick-scan limits have regression tests
checks.limitations: Private Git access depends on host credentials; dynamic validation remains blocked until an authorized runtime target is configured.

checks.metric: Precision, false-positive rate, and recall for SCA/SAST/AGENT
checks.target: Versioned labeled positive and negative corpus with per-module thresholds
checks.limitations: Functional fixtures and live project findings are not a labeled effectiveness benchmark.

checks.metric: Repeated DAST verdict agreement and evidence completeness
checks.target: Versioned replay corpus with repeated-run agreement and evidence-completeness thresholds
checks.limitations: Existing validations prove workflow execution, not a general reproducibility rate.

checks.metric: Manifest parsing and scan completion across documented ecosystems
checks.target: Pinned fixture matrix for every documented ecosystem, language, package manager, and supported version
checks.current: Parsers and representative tests exist; a versioned compatibility matrix does not
checks.limitations: Documented parser support is not a certified success rate for arbitrary projects.

checks.metric: Sandbox policy enforcement and escape resistance
checks.target: Versioned negative corpus covering network, filesystem, process, capability, resource, secret, and escape boundaries
checks.current: Policy tests and deterministic safe/MCP fixtures pass in the supported local environment
checks.limitations: The platform is not eBPF/Sysmon/EDR and has no independent container escape assessment.

checks.metric: Production deployment, IAM, tenant isolation, evidence protection, backup, and recovery
checks.target: Threat-modeled production architecture and tested operational controls
checks.limitations: The current release is explicitly limited to a controlled single-host development environment.
